prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, producing a win in 1 of 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), which won its single test, as well as for all other change categories with 1 test.
Copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all non-winning tests.
Both winning tests (sign_in, reorder and finish, new_screen) were significantly underpredicted.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pick Friend Screen with Carousel Layout: Redesign the pick_friend adoption screen into a interactive carousel layout showcasing animated pet preview cards. (why: Adoption stage has low conversion (60.9%) and long decision times (median 89s / mean 1017s).)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Adoption Certificate Step: Move sign_in to appear after adoption_certificate so users pick and personalize their pet before signing in. (why: Reordering sign_in won its single past test, and delaying friction until after adoption commitment boosts overall completion (currently 21.9%).)
2: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Checklist Layout with Fast Path Highlights: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a checklist style contrasting instant pick path versus custom pet creation path. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or decision paralysis during initial path selection.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines Tip Component: Add a dedicated guidance hint component on upload_photos explaining ideal photo lighting and single-pet focus. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, contributing to adoption step drop-off.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Account Pet Protection Badge Notification: Add a highlighted safety badge component to sign_in assuring users that signing in preserves existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing drop-off and friction at sign_in.)
5: [home, redesign] Redesign Waiting Screen Split Layout with Animated Mascot Progress: Redesign the waiting screen layout into a split layout featuring an animated mascot previewing desktop pet behaviors while generation completes. (why: The waiting home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; visual engagement during wait prevents drop-off.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Mascot Welcome Copy Refresh: Update story screen copy to clearly describe how the desktop pet lives, walks, and reacts on top of work apps. (why: choose_path mean time (514s) indicates early user uncertainty about what a desktop pet app actually does.)

Choose path layout changes showed no gain (+0.0%) in previous tests, and cost is moderate to high.
Strong evidence from funnel and 3 support emails on pet creation failures, but past hint tests have performed poorly.
Directly targets 8 support complaints, but copy and notification changes have consistently failed to drive positive lift.
Home step has lowest drop-off; previous wait-time and layout changes on home showed no clear positive effect.
Cheap config change, but copy changes on choose_path (-1.7%) and overall copy tweaks have failed to generate positive lift.
